reviews.title: Decent quality at a great price.
reviews.comment: This PSU might look like a cheap and crappy unit... BUT IT's not!!! The specs are there (I opened and analyzed the components.) While it is cheap, and the components are not top tier, they are of decent quality and perform up to spec even under extreme conditions. All the protections you need are there and they work correctly. All in all a decent quality power supply for a mainstream budget build.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Thing works better than expected
reviews.comment: Works just as expected, easily installable, and makes a quiet humming noise. Even though there is a lot of cords this is a perfect psu for your pc.
